name: Apple Intelligence Siri False Advertising Settlement
aliases: apple; apple store; apple inc; apple.com
payout_note: $25 per device, adjusted pro rata; up to $95 if few people file
eligibility_summary: US residents who bought an iPhone 15 Pro, 15 Pro Max or any iPhone 16 model in the US between June 10, 2024 and March 29, 2025.

name: Amazon Returns Settlement ($309.5M)
eligibility_summary: Amazon customers whose refund for a returned product was missing, late, incorrect or charged back on or after September 5, 2017. Subclass A is paid automatically; Subclass B must file with the Notice ID.

name: CVS Digital Privacy Settlement
aliases: cvs; cvs pharmacy; cvs health; cvs.com; extracare
payout_note: Up to $5 with no documentation, up to $10 with proof such as dated screenshots
eligibility_summary: Anyone who used a CVS website, the CVS Health website or the CVS app in the US before July 27, 2026. A store visit alone does not count; one claim per household.

name: Dr. Squatch "Natural" Labels Settlement
aliases: dr. squatch; dr squatch; drsquatch; squatch
payout_note: $0.50 per product: 5 products on attestation, up to 25 with receipts
eligibility_summary: People who bought Dr. Squatch personal care products labeled "natural" in the US between November 1, 2018 and August 29, 2026.

name: Levoit Air Purifier "HEPA" Labels Settlement
eligibility_summary: People who bought a Levoit Core or EverestAir air purifier or replacement filter labeled "True HEPA", "HEPA" or "H13" in the US between August 29, 2019 and August 4, 2023. Proof of purchase date required.

name: Thinkware Dash Cam Settlement
payout_note: About $6.70 per camera; one camera without a receipt
eligibility_summary: Drivers who bought a Thinkware X700, F200PRO, F70PRO, DC-M2-FG or DC-M2-FG-IR dash cam in the US between January 25, 2019 and August 31, 2024.

name: Bestway Above-Ground Pools Settlement ($15M)
payout_note: $40 without a receipt, or 10% of the price with proof of purchase
eligibility_summary: People who bought a Bestway-branded above-ground pool 48 inches or taller, with compression straps outside the support poles, sold between 2008 and 2024.

name: Flo Period Tracker Privacy Settlement ($59.5M)
aliases: flo; flo health; flo.health; flo app
payout_note: Pro rata share of $59.5M; California residents may get a double share
eligibility_summary: US users who logged period or pregnancy data in the Flo app between November 2016 and February 2019. No Unique ID or PIN needed.

name: TED Video Privacy Settlement (Sutton v. TED Foundation)
aliases: ted; ted conferences; ted foundation; ted.com
payout_note: Two free months of membership (valued at $10+) automatically, or $5 cash with a claim
eligibility_summary: US TED account holders who watched a pre-recorded video on ted.com or the TED iOS/Android apps between October 19, 2021 and July 14, 2026.

name: MDLive Patient Portal Privacy Settlement ($3.5M)
eligibility_summary: MDLive users who signed in to patient.mdlive.com and used the portal between May 30, 2023 and August 11, 2025, and had an active Facebook or Google account then.

name: Equifax Hard Inquiry Dispute Settlement ($30M)
eligibility_summary: US residents who disputed one or more hard inquiries on their credit report with Equifax between Aug 31, 2021 and Mar 27, 2026 (General Dispute Group); a larger payment applies to some mailed disputes back to Oct 4, 2016.

name: Lands' End Data Breach Settlement
aliases: lands' end; lands end; landsend; landsend.com
payout_note: About $60 with no receipts, or up to $5,000 documented, plus 2 years of monitoring
eligibility_summary: People affected by the December 2024 Lands' End data breach (those sent a notice). Login ID and PIN from the notice are required.

name: Equinox, Inc. Data Breach Settlement
payout_note: Estimated $100 pro rata and/or up to $5,000 documented, plus up to 3 years of monitoring
eligibility_summary: US residents who were sent a notice by Equinox, Inc. (Albany, NY nonprofit health provider) that their information may have been affected in the data incident detected on or about April 29, 2024.

name: Autobell Car Wash Data Breach Settlement
payout_note: $45 with no documentation, or up to $5,000 documented, plus 2 years of credit monitoring
eligibility_summary: People notified of the April 2024 cyberattack on the Autobell Car Wash chain.

name: Venetian Las Vegas Website Privacy Settlement ($1.6M)
aliases: venetian; the venetian; venetian resort; venetian las vegas; venetianlasvegas.com
payout_note: About $71.39 for bookers, about $3.60 for browsers
eligibility_summary: California residents who booked a stay on venetianlasvegas.com, or browsed the site, while in California between September 18, 2024 and March 16, 2026.

name: Raging Waters Processing Fee Settlement ($850K)
payout_note: Pro rata share of about $483,000 net, calculated from Raging Waters' records
eligibility_summary: US residents who bought admission tickets on ragingwaters.com between June 1, 2020 and June 22, 2026 and paid a "Processing Fee". Notice ID and Confirmation Code required.

name: Kroger Prescription Pricing Settlement ($17M)
aliases: kroger; kroger pharmacy; ralphs; fred meyer
payout_note: Pro rata share of $17M, weighted by amount paid
eligibility_summary: People in the US who paid anything toward a prescription filled with insurance at a Kroger-owned pharmacy between December 9, 2018 and August 23, 2026. Notice ID and Confirmation Code required.
